priceSnapshot.source: OKX public API /market/candles for BTC-USDT, read at 06:58 COT. Three granularities read within one minute of each other agree inside 3 points: the in-progress 1H bar opening 2026-08-22T11:00Z prints 77,121.9, the in-progress 4H bar opening 08:00Z prints 77,121.9 and the in-progress 15m bar opening 11:45Z printed 77,119.8 sixty seconds earlier. FRESHNESS GUARD APPLIED AND IT MATTERED AGAIN. The first read of every candle endpoint came back from the run proxy's cache with a newest stamp of 07:00Z - byte-identical to what the midnight run saw five hours ago, right down to the 77,599.2 close. Those were DISCARDED. Changing the limit parameter forced a cache miss and returned genuinely current series: 15m limit=30 (newest bar 11:45Z), 1H limit=222 (newest 11:00Z), 4H limit=211 (newest 08:00Z) and 1D limit=240 (newest 00:00Z, in-progress). changePct is measured against the settled 1H close exactly twenty-four bars back, the 2026-08-21T11:00Z bar at 76,730.1: 77,121.9 / 76,730.1 - 1 = +0.51 percent.
priceSnapshot.note: Against the midnight report's 77,599.2 spot is DOWN 477.3 points, or 0.62 percent, in four hours and thirty-eight minutes. The path matters more than the number: the 10:00Z hour flushed to 76,529.9 - just 14.9 points above the 76,515.0 line the midnight run drew as its reduce level - and then bought back 592 points inside eighty minutes. The line held on a genuine test for the second time in six hours, and again it was never a settled close: the lowest settled 1H close since the midnight snapshot is 76,970.3. sessionRange is measured from the 07:15Z 15m bar onward, i.e. since the midnight portfolio snapshot at 02:20 COT.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below $76,515.0 - unchanged from the midnight report, and now twice-defended. The 05:00Z bar traded exactly to it and the 10:00Z bar came within 14.9 points of it (76,529.9), and on both occasions the hour closed hundreds of points above. Spot sits 606.9 points above the line, which is 0.84 of an hourly ATR, so a single ordinary hour can reach it without meaning anything. The trigger is a settled CLOSE. A third test that finally closes through says the buyers who have absorbed two flushes are done, and the next verified shelf is 76,222.2.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close above $77,519.1 - the high of this session and 207.8 points above the 1H EMA20 at 77,311.30. This LOWERS the midnight gate from 78,832.2, and the reason is honest rather than convenient: the tape has since made a lower high, and 78,832.2 is now 1,710 points away, far enough that it stopped being a decision the next few hours could make. A settled close above 77,519.1 reclaims the 1H EMA20 that price is currently trading beneath and is the first real evidence the cooling has finished.

decisionBox.changed: Stance stays ADD and a second tranche goes in, but the add gate drops from 78,832.2 to 77,519.1 and the reduce line stays put at 76,515.0. The logic is the retest logic: the midnight run bought at 77,599.2 saying it would defend 76,515.0; that level was tested to within 14.9 points and bought back, so the thesis was paid for rather than abandoned. This tranche is smaller than midnight's and it is 477 points lower.

liquidityMagnet.source: OKX public API /public/liquidation-orders (instType=SWAP, uly=BTC-USDT, state=filled), contracts converted at ctVal 0.01 BTC. Window covers 10:03:55Z to 11:45:38Z - the newest print was seconds old at read time, so this feed is genuinely fresh, unlike the candle, open-interest and account-ratio endpoints this run.
liquidityMagnet.note: The pull has FLIPPED since midnight and that is the single most important change in this report. Six hours ago shorts were being liquidated 11.3 to 1. Over the last 101 minutes it is the reverse: 366,391 USD of LONGS forced to sell against 205,368 USD of shorts, 1.78 to 1 the other way, and the long-side clusters sit BELOW spot between 76,519.6 and 76,790 while the short-side prints are packed at 77,089 to 77,216, straddling spot rather than standing above it. Below-spot forced flow (366,391 USD) is 5.72 times the above-spot forced flow (64,094 USD), so the honest read is a downward pull. The mitigating detail, and it is real: the sequence ran long-flush first and short-squeeze second, and every print in the last sixty-five minutes has been a short being bought back. Some of the fuel under 76,700 has already burned. Scale caveat unchanged - 571,759 USD in total is small for a venue this size, so this is a directional tell about the last hour and a half, not evidence of a large standing pool of resting liquidity.

The verified streak is FOUR consecutive settled inflow days - 17 Aug +297.5m, 18 Aug +189.3m, 19 Aug +517.2m, 20 Aug +606.3m, totalling +1,610.3m - preceded by two negative days (13 Aug -131.1m, 14 Aug -56.2m). calibration.note: Both midnight gates are resolved and both are FALSE. The reduce line was a settled 1H close below 76,515.0. The 10:00Z bar traded to 76,529.9, missing the level by 14.9 points, and closed at 76,970.3 - the lowest settled 1H close of the session, 455.3 points above the line. reduce_fired is false, and note that this is the second consecutive session in which the tape has come to that shelf and failed to close through it. The add line was a settled 1H close above 78,832.2; the session high was 77,519.1, some 1,313 points short, so add_fired is false and it was never in question. On the action: midnight put 24.00 USDT into the spot core at 77,599.2 and spot is now 77,121.9, so that tranche is down 477.3 points or 0.62 percent - about 0.15 USDT on 24. acting_helped is FALSE and the desk should say so plainly. The defence is that the level midnight named as its reason was tested and held, so the thesis is intact even though the entry was early; the criticism is that buying 0.6 percent below a lower high with daily RSI at 85 is buying into a cooling, and a patient desk would have waited for the retest it said it wanted rather than front-running it at the top of the range.
